title: Homotopies in Batalin-Vilkovisky Formalism
summary: We review the notion of homotopy of quantum master actions in geometric Batalin-Vilkovisky formalism. Then we construct new examples of such homotopies, coming from renormalization group flow and non-infinitesimal changes of gauge fixing. Finally, we use the field redefinitions given by these homotopies to construct spans of quantum master actions with isomorphic effective actions.
